newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokian Renkaat Jan-Aug profit seen higher.
newsitem.headline: Nokian Renkaat Jan-Aug profit seen higher.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 49 million markka median forecast for tyres manufacturer Nokian Renkaat Oy's 8-month profit after financial items, before extraordinaries.
The results are due on October 2 at 0800/0500 GMT.
In January-August 1995, Nokian Renkaat posted a 41 million markka profit. Nokian Renkaat said on June 6, it expected full-year 1996 earnings per share to at least match last year's 6.93 markka level.

For Nokian Renkaat's full-year 1996 profit, seven of the eight analysts polled gave a median forecast profit after financial items and before extraordinaries of 107 million markka (mean 110 million) in a 104-127 million markka range. The corresponding 1995 profit was 96 million markka. @
Full-year 1996 EPS was seen at 7.60 markka (mean 7.79 markka) in a 7.5-8.7 markka range.
The data was collected in the fourth week of September and on September 30.
Contributors to the survey were ABB Aros Securities, Carnegie, Enskilda, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Interbank, Merita Securities and Opstock.
